lines.t: Shadows fall across the broken land,
Prophet’s voice, the ancient command.
YahuShua walks the burning sand,
Truth in hand, to heal and stand.
Wake the soul, the light will rise,
Messiah’s dawn floods midnight skies.
Chains will break and night will flee,
In YahuShua we’re finally free.
Lines inscribed in the sacred scrolls,
Mystery veiled yet it consoles.
Risen King who bends the skies,
The Rock on which all hope relies.
Wake the soul, the light will rise,
Messiah’s dawn floods midnight skies.
Chains will break and night will flee,
In YahuShua we’re finally free.
Silent storms, the tempests cry,
Calm within the endless sky.
Truth revealed, the veil removed,
By the Lamb we are renewed.
Wake the soul, the light will rise,
Messiah’s dawn floods midnight skies.
Chains will break and night will flee,
In YahuShua we’re finally free.
In fire’s glow, in water’s grace,
YahuShua holds sacred space.
Forevermore, the truth will reign,
The Volume’s voice, the Lamb’s refrain.
